Osmosis is the movement of solvent through a semipermeable membrane.
The solvent in osmosis is water.
In osmosis, solvent moves from low solute concentration to high solute concentration.
Plant roots absorb water by osmosis.
Reverse osmosis applies external pressure on the concentrated side.
In reverse osmosis, solvent moves from high concentration to low concentration.
Reverse osmosis is used for desalination of seawater.
Reverse osmosis is used for purification of water.
Reverse osmosis removes ions from water.
Reverse osmosis removes bacteria from water.
